purpose: Frozen daily simulation identification; hardware defaults unchanged

calibration.terminal_policy: Exclude the final raw-position-confirmed contact of EVERY run and its outgoing flight; unconfirmed later observer events cannot turn that contact back into training data.
calibration.uncertainty_assignment: Run and flight accelerations plus smooth residual forcing; independent high-frequency noise and timestamp jitter. No duplicate full position residual.
calibration.balancing: Global fits, flight/impact pools and capture jitter balanced by run; smooth/noise/timing pools retain measured event frequency.
calibration.latency: Current C++ runs only; candidate solve-time differences must be calibrated separately.

limitations: Effective fitted gravity includes aerodynamic and capture-clock/model bias; not an independent physical gravity measurement.
Terminal contacts excluded from fitting. Finite-data empirical uncertainty is not a robust bound or rare-event guarantee.
Spin unobserved; normal/restitution/spin and plane displacement/contact timing are partly confounded.
Independent recombination can be conservative; white-noise fourth differences must not be temporally block-bootstrapped.
Velocity-servo impulse plant does not reproduce Franka collision reflex or measured torque sensor tails.
Elliptical planar contact does not model 3D side/rim grazing.
